builds.title: Phanaton canopy lookout, Fighter 1
builds.speed: 9. Glide 50 feet each round, subject to starting height and load.
skills: Mountaineering and Rope Use as learned proficiencies.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Chaotic good. AC 4 from natural AC 9, the racial 2-point bonus, and Dexterity improving AC by 3. No armor or shield.
After the racial bonus, saves are 12/14/13/15/15 for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell.
Charisma is 11 or 10 with the peoples affected by his racial penalty and 3 with araneas.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.
actions: Wooden club, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6 bludgeoning against small or medium targets or 1d3 against large targets. Speed factor 4.
Glide up to three times the starting height at 50 feet per round. Subtract 20 feet of range per 100 coin-weight carried. Makurí cannot attack while gliding.
builds.tactics: Makurí leads from above. He lands to fight and uses his staff as a club if someone reaches the lookout.

builds.title: Shazak waterline scout, Fighter 1
builds.speed: 9 on land. Use Swimming proficiency in water.
skills: Swimming as a bonus proficiency. Fishing and Direction Sense as learned proficiencies.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Neutral good. Natural AC 5 from scales. No armor or shield. Strength 16 adds 1 damage and gives no attack bonus.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.
actions: Steel-tipped spear, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6+1 piercing against small or medium targets or 1d8+1 against large targets. Speed factor 6.
builds.tactics: Zesk waits in the shallows, then retreats with the ferry crew if the water rises.

builds.title: Wallara outback guide, Fighter 1 with the Wilderness Warrior kit
skills: Tracking 11 before terrain adjustments. Ancient History and Local History as racial bonus proficiencies.
Outback Survival 18 and Endurance from the Wilderness Warrior kit. A roll of 20 still fails Survival.
Club as a tribal weapon proficiency.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Neutral good. Natural AC 9 improved by 2 from Dexterity. Unarmored to preserve vanish.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Charisma 10 with most other humanoids and 9 with humans and demihumans. Always finds the way back when within 10 miles of home or camp.
At 1st level, Werrami can vanish. Blending becomes available at 3rd level. His home in Wallara grants no initial Legacy.
actions: Wooden club, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6 bludgeoning against small or medium targets or 1d3 against large targets. Speed factor 4.
Vanish as his full action on an Intelligence check of 13 or less on d20. Jump up to 120 feet without materializing in a solid object. He may try each round.
builds.tactics: When cornered, Werrami vanishes behind cover. He returns once he can approach unseen.

builds.title: Lupin scent-led courier, Ranger 1
builds.senses: Infravision 60 feet, keen hearing and smell.
skills: Tracking 20 before situational modifiers (Wisdom 14 + 6). Detect Noise 35%. Bonus Blind-fighting.
Short sword as a weapon proficiency.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Neutral good. Coat is ordinary clothing. Base AC 10 improved by 1 from Dexterity.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Lightly equipped ranger. Hide in Shadows 10% and Move Silently 15% in natural surroundings. Halve these chances in unfamiliar enclosed or urban conditions.

Against his chosen species enemy, gnolls, attack at +4 and take −4 on reactions. Célan can befriend a calm animal. A wild or attack-trained animal must fail a save against rods at −1 for him to shift its reaction by one category.
Recognizes werewolves in any form 99% of the time or another lupin in an unusual form 15% of the time. An invisible or ethereal creature within 10 feet triggers a +4 detection save each round.

Recognizes familiar peoples by scent and makes an Intelligence check to identify a known individual by scent. Strong odors impose −1 to −4. Take −2 on saving throws against sound or odor. Swallowed wolfsbane kills on a failed poison save or costs 20 HP on a success. Injected wolfsbane halves ability scores for 1d3 days on a failed poison save.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.
actions: Short sword, THAC0 20. One melee attack for 1d6 piercing against small or medium targets or 1d8 against large targets. Speed factor 3.
builds.tactics: Célan tracks from the edge of the road, relays the route quietly, and draws his sword only if the trail leads into a fight.

builds.title: Rakasta skirmisher, Fighter 1
skills: Front claws as a natural weapon proficiency, which also covers war claws.
traits: Base THAC0 20. Standard 1d10 initiative, low roll acts first.
Chaotic good. Unarmored. Base AC 10 improved by 3 from Dexterity.
Saves, in order for paralyzation/poison/death, rod/staff/wand, petrification/polymorph, breath, and spell, are 14/16/15/17/17.
Half falling damage. Saves against sound suffer −1. An invisible or ethereal creature within 10 feet triggers a +4 detection save each round.
Raised beyond the Red Curse and encountered there, with no initial Legacy.
actions: Paired war claws, THAC0 20 for each attack, speed factor 1. Roll two separate attacks per round without a two-weapon penalty. Each hit deals 1d4+1 slashing against small or medium targets or 1d3+1 against large targets.
Without the fittings, roll the two natural front-claw attacks separately using THAC0 20 for 1d2+1 slashing each. Speed factor 1.
builds.tactics: Sava crosses ledges the patrol avoids. She turns to drive back the first pursuer if the cart needs time.

concepts.name: Makurí
concepts.motive: Find a route that bypasses a split rope bridge before the next rain.
concepts.hook: Makurí can glide across the gap with a line once the party clears the far landing.

concepts.name: Zesk Reedmark
concepts.motive: Keep the night ferry open while displaced families come downriver.
concepts.hook: Zesk found a safe ford and needs one person to carry its marker line back.

concepts.name: Werrami
concepts.motive: Walk a missing survey crew back to water before the afternoon heat.
concepts.hook: Werrami reads the crew’s tracks and offers to scout the gully ahead.

concepts.name: Célan Merle
concepts.speciesPublication: Savage Coast Campaign Book, Part 2: Player Characters
concepts.motive: Find the partner who was supposed to meet him at the tollhouse.
concepts.hook: Célan recognizes her scent halfway down the bridge, where the trail abruptly disappears.

concepts.name: Sava Flintstep
concepts.speciesPublication: Savage Coast Campaign Book, Part 2: Player Characters
concepts.motive: Keep a delivery cart out of the hands of a rival patrol.
concepts.hook: Sava offers to lure the patrol along a ledge while the party takes the cart below.
